method: Playwright browser sweep over every accordion-linked spec route
cleanup: Open demo popups were closed after each route to isolate subsequent cases.
limitations: This sweep exercises generic activation paths. Component-specific arrow-key, drag, swipe, file-upload, timeout, and screen-reader assertions remain represented in the interaction coverage matrix and should be promoted to dedicated Playwright tests when a committed browser runner is added.
The sweep does not claim pixel-perfect approval; visual evidence requires retained screenshots at approved viewports.
